evidence: Films were deposited by alternating exposure to LiHMDS and anhydrous HF. The self-limiting properties of the process were explored by investing the inﬂuence of precursor delivery time and purge time on the resulting ﬁlm thickness. Each ALD cycle involved a single LiHDMS exposure, followed by a purging of the vacuum chamber with inert gas, and then HF exposure along with an additional purge. ALD experiments were performed using Ar (Matheson Tri-Gas, 6N purity, Newark, CA, USA) as the purge and carrier gas;
